zh.caption: 圖 1｜三個訊號加上我方證據，支撐排序判斷
zh.description: 前三項是平行訊號，第四項是共同判讀情境；沒有數值相加、因果箭頭或固定處理順序。

items.title: CVSS｜技術嚴重度
items.body: 保留版本、類型、向量與來源；分數不能直接代表我方被駭機率。

items.title: KEV｜已知利用證據
items.body: 保存列入狀態與查核日期；外部利用不等於我方已入侵，未列也不能忽略。

items.title: EPSS｜未來 30 天預測
items.body: 機率與百分位分開保存；低分或缺分數不能證明安全。

items.title: 我方資產與風險情境
items.body: 先核對完整版本、設定與修補，再看入口曝露、重要性、後果與現有防護；記下排序理由。

en.caption: Figure 1 | Three signals plus local evidence inform priority
en.description: The first three are parallel signals; the fourth is their shared decision context. No numerical sum, causal arrow or fixed action order is implied.

items.title: CVSS | Technical severity
items.body: Keep the version, type, vector and source. The score is not our probability of compromise.

items.title: KEV | Known exploitation evidence
items.body: Keep the listing status and check date. External exploitation is not local intrusion; absence does not justify ignoring a flaw.

items.title: EPSS | Next 30 days forecast
items.body: Keep probability separate from percentile. A low or missing score does not establish safety.

items.title: Our assets and risk context
items.body: Check complete versions, configuration and patches, then exposure, importance, consequences and existing defenses. Record the prioritization rationale.
